study: Independent fixed-weight retail comparison V6; not recovery or replacement of V5 or the failed teacher probe.
generation: Each random/failure arm gets exactly three independent scheduled attempts, including all rejections; no extra attempts after inspecting outcomes. Both use the same gpt-6-astra low configuration.

budget.actual_http_attempts_tokens_and_dollars: Not bounded by logical turns; report native usage and unknown values separately.

availability.rule: One separately accounted request; only start the study if it completes. No inference that this guarantees subsequent availability.

partitions: Original authored train 2 / validation 1 / test 2 from V5, native reference and negative calibration before any study model call. No final test outcome has been observed.
final_test: Open only after all arm selections are frozen. Report every arm and baseline even without improvement; incomparable when any pool/search/result is ineligible or unknown.
infrastructure_failure: Stop on terminal API failure or unknown turn. Read the original turn only; no resubmission or automatic new independent study.
analysis: Descriptive comparison on two authored held-out compound tasks. Report generation acceptance, prompt constraints, training repair/regression, held-out change and per-phase native cost; no population-level significance claim.
selection_bias: V4/V5 and the bounded teacher probe remain reported. Implementation/budget changes were informed by those failed attempts; V6 is an independent implementation validation, not a confirmatory replication.
